description: This file defines the EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class to manage search filter parameters related to employee supervisors, specifically focusing on storing and retrieving an employee number and setting a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for capturing filter parameters when searching for employee supervisors, allowing to filter by employee number and sorting by supervisor's last name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'supervisor.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
